title: Workflow output
description: Every merger workflow returns this. status values depend on the workflow (PLAN_READY, APPROVED, MIGRATED, HEALED, RECONCILED, VERIFIED, CUTOVER_COMPLETE, ...).

type.description: What should happen next, e.g. NONE, EXECUTE_PLAN, SELF_HEAL, REPLAY_RECORDS, ROLLBACK, MANUAL_REVIEW, FOLLOW_UP

evidence.description: Plain-language lines a person can read
